name: Lead intake and enrichment

parameters.content:
## Lead intake and enrichment
Web form → dedupe → AI qualifies → CRM row → follow-up draft for approval.

**Guards:** spam rules override the model · instructions inside a form are flagged and can't make a lead hot · drafts that mention prices, discounts or delivery promises are flagged · every draft waits for approval.

**AI off:** the keyword baseline decides.

nodes.name: Load sample data
nodes.notes: Invented, labelled items served by the mock services

nodes.name: Look up CRM
nodes.notes: Same email or phone already in the CRM?

nodes.name: Check duplicates
nodes.notes: CRM matches plus repeats in this batch

nodes.name: Apply lead rules
nodes.notes: Spam and injection rules override the model

nodes.name: AI switched on?
nodes.notes: Off: the rule-based path handles everything

nodes.name: Queue follow-up for approval
nodes.notes: Waits for a salesperson; never sent automatically

description: Web-form leads are deduplicated, qualified by AI within fixed rules, written to the CRM sheet, and given a follow-up draft that waits for a salesperson's approval. Nothing is emailed automatically.
